title: A case study of ethical bridges: wastewater-based epidemiology in the Rubbertown Air Toxics and Health Assessment (RATHA) project
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,1363-1368
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00234F, Perspective
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kathleen Clarke, Lauren B. Anderson, Arnita Gadson, Rochelle H. Holm, Avery Kolers, Ted Smith
This case study underscores both the need for and the feasibility of ethical planning in environmental health research, particularly when using wastewater-based epidemiology in vulnerable communities.
